user.title: Kärcher Home Robots — Region
user.description: Select the region that matches your Kärcher Home account. This determines the cloud endpoint and cannot be changed after setup.

credentials.title: Kärcher Home Robots — Sign in
credentials.description: Enter the email and password for your Kärcher Home account.

device.title: Kärcher Home Robots — Select device
device.description: Your account has multiple robots. Select the one to add.

reauth_confirm.title: Kärcher Home Robots — Re-authenticate
reauth_confirm.description: Your session has expired. Re-enter the password for {email}.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid email or password. Check your Kärcher Home credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Kärcher cloud. Check your network and try again.
error.no_devices: No robots found on this account. Make sure the robot is registered in the Kärcher Home app.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.

abort.device_not_found: The selected device could not be found. Please restart the flow.

cloud_outage_persistent.title: Kärcher Home Robots — cloud unreachable
cloud_outage_persistent.description: The Kärcher cloud has been unreachable for over an hour. This is usually a temporary vendor outage rather than a problem with your network or this integration. Your robot's entities will recover automatically when the cloud returns — no action is required.
